FROM: titles s (series) JOIN episodes e ON s.id = e.parent_id JOIN titles ep (episode) ON e.id = ep.id

JOIN.desc: 剧集ID → 剧集标题/评分

GROUP_BY: s.id, s.primary_title, e.season_number (season_ratings CTE)；s.id, s.primary_title (series_stats CTE)
LIMIT: 通过 run_sql limit 参数控制（不写SQL LIMIT）

subproblems.desc: 计算每个系列每季的平均评分：按 series_id, series_title, season_number 分组，AVG(ep.average_rating) 作为 season_avg_rating
对每个系列聚合：计算总季数、最大/最小季号，并通过 CASE WHEN 提取首季(season_number=MIN)和末季(season_number=MAX)的平均评分
计算下降幅度 decline_rate_pct = (first_season_rating - last_season_rating) / first_season_rating * 100，按下降幅度降序排列
